'''Bene''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order]] who lived during the [[Republic Era|final years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. In the waning [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Clone Wars]], Bene was [[Death|killed]] by the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] during the execution of [[Order 66]] and the [[Operation: Knightfall|siege]] of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]].

==Biography==
[[File:CinDrallig.png|thumb|left|250px|The death of Padawan Bene was recorded by the Jedi Temple's security cameras and viewed by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi.]]
Bene was a [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] during the final [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Clone Wars]], when [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], who was secretly the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious, declared the [[Jedi Order]] [[Treason|traitors]] to the [[Galactic Republic]]. Executing [[Order 66]] on [[Coruscant]], the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] and the [[501st Legion]] [[Operation: Knightfall|marched]] on the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] to [[Great Jedi Purge|purge]] its occupants, including Bene. As the [[clone trooper]]s stormed the [[Jedi temple|Temple]], Bene fought alongside Padawan [[Whie Malreaux]] and [[Battlemaster]] [[Cin Drallig]] against Vader.<ref name="Episode III" /> Despite their combined efforts, Bene, Malreaux and Drallig were [[Death|killed]] by the new [[Lord]] of the [[Sith]] with Malreaux being the first to fall. Bene then attacked Vader in concert with Drallig, but Vader batted Bene's blade aside before grabbing her by the throat and strangling her whilst he dueled Drallig one-handed, killing the trainee Jedi before finishing off Drallig.<ref name="SWE" />

The [[Lightsaber duel|duel]] between Bene and Vader was recorded by the Temple's surveillance system, allowing [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to discover her fate while reviewing the security logs. Recognizing the Sith who led the attack as his one-[[time]] apprentice, [[Jedi Knight]] Anakin Skywalker, Kenobi deactivated the [[Hologram|holographic]] recording as he was unable to watch it through to its completion. Bene's death along with the other Jedi in the Temple led Kenobi to [[Duel on Mustafar|confront]] Vader on [[Mustafar]], where the former friends fought until Kenobi emerged as the victor.<ref name="Episode III" />

==Personality and traits==
Bene was a young [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who, at the time of the Clone Wars, possessed [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and fair skin. She rallied to the Temple's defense, opposing a former Jedi-turned-Sith and his [[legion]] of [[Cloning|clones]]. She was among the Jedi who tried to defeat Vader, but ultimately died defending the Temple.<ref name="Episode III" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a Jedi, Bene was [[Force-sensitive]]—a being who possessed a strong [[Midi-chlorian|connection]] to [[the Force]].<ref name="Jedi">According to the {{Databank|jedi-order|Jedi Order}}, the Jedi were an order of protectors unified by their ability to tap into the power of the Force.</ref> She was [[Jedi training|trained]] in [[lightsaber combat]], possessing a blue lightsaber, though her dueling skills did not help her to defeat Vader.<ref name="Episode III" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Mousy McCallum]], daughter of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]] producer [[Rick McCallum]], portrayed Bene in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Episode III" />
